title: VarRate：免训练可变速率KV缓存压缩技术用于长上下文大语言模型
summary: VarRate是一种免训练的可变低秩KV缓存压缩方法，通过按查询显著性分配每个token的秩预算，避免token丢弃，在20%预算下性能接近未压缩模型，优于现有方法。
summary_en: VarRate is a training-free variable-rate KV cache compression method that allocates low-rank budgets per token based on query salience, avoiding token eviction. At 20% budget, it stays within 0.8 points of uncompressed model on LongBench, outperforming existing methods.
